verdict.rationale: Ollama's own surfaces let you chat directly with a model: `ollama run` ("Run and chat with Gemma 4") and the new macOS/Windows app, where reviewers report multimodal and Markdown support working. That is a basic built-in assistant you can hand prompts to. The agentic delegation it advertises (`ollama launch`, OpenClaw) runs third-party agents like Claude Code and Codex on top of Ollama's models, so it earns no credit as a built-in assistant. missing for 10: a documented first-party agent that carries out multi-step tasks or tool actions, any documentation of the app's assistant capabilities beyond basic chat, and hands-on evidence of delegating real tasks inside the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
